summary.text: Matthew McQueen is a Democrat who has served in the New Mexico House of Representatives since 2015, representing District 50 in Sandoval and Santa Fe counties.
McQueen chairs the House Energy, Environment and Natural Resources Committee and also sits on the House Judiciary Committee.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's member page lists McQueen's occupation as attorney and a district office in Santa Fe.
Between sessions, McQueen is a member of the Land Grant Committee and the Water and Natural Resources Committee.
